Class CommonModel.StationClassData

java.lang.Object
common.definitions.CommonModel.StationClassData
Enclosing class:
CommonModel
protected class CommonModel.StationClassData extends Object
This class contains all of the data which can be defined for a combination of class and station. These data include queue policy, service time distribution and routing strategy
